verdict.rationale: Speechmatics offers a web platform for building voice AI agents and tokens for automating workspace administration, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about version history, change review or rollback for agents, configurations or automations. Admin-automation tokens and job deletion are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
